data.one_liner: Wrapper that allows importing web APIs in non-web environments
data.what_it_does: It provides non-functional stubs for all interfaces from package:web so that code can be compiled for web and native. The stubs can be imported but will throw if used on non-web platforms.
use_when: You need to share code that imports web APIs across web and native targets
You want a drop‑in replacement for package:web during development
avoid_when: You actually need to execute web APIs on a non-web platform
You want to avoid runtime errors from stubs
strengths: Easy to add as a dependency
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Stubs are non-functional and will throw if called on non-web
Only useful for import compatibility, not for actual functionality
